Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support - III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Project Technical Support - III. This is a contractual position for candidates with a psychology background.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support - III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support - III post in AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support - III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 33,600 per month, which includes Rs. 28,000 per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Three Years Graduate degree in a relevant subject/field with three years of experience, or a PG degree in relevant Psychology/Clinical Psychology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support - III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the AIIMS Bhopal office. The exact address and timing will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
